newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Feb 26.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Jaime Cardinal Sin, archbishop of Manila, cautioned the faithful on Tuesday on what he called the two grave threats to democracy - the extension of the term of the President and proposals to alter the Constitution. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- President Ramos yesterday vowed to alleviate poverty which he described as the unfinished task of the "People Power Revolution" that restored democracy 11 years ago. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- With piercing sirens, China bade farewell on Tuesday to Deng Xiaoping, as 10,000 of the nation's Communist elite gathered in Beijing's Great Hall of the People to mourn his passing. (CHRONICLE/BULLETIN)
